text:
maria: Heads-up — quickstart CI flaky on sampleapp-smoke. Failing 3/5 runs. Cutover in ~4h. Need proposed unblock plan so changelog cutoff isn't missed.

kevin: Can you paste the failing job link? :eyes:

ci-bot: Build 1747011101 — https://ci.internal/redwood/quickstart-smoke/1747011101 — fail: tests/integration/test_network_retry.py::test_retry_backoff (timeout)

sam: Saw that locally — it flakes on slower GPU runners. Repro ~60% on xlarge.

anita: Docs + quickstart demos depend on that sampleapp passing. I can hold changelog for 1hr but not much longer.

kevin: I can whip up a small fix (increase timeout + extra retry). Want me to open a PR? @maria

maria: Please open PR. Fallback plan: approved skip flag for release smoke -> QUCI_SKIP_FLAKY=1 (must be explicit opt-in).

jen: Changelog cutoff is 18:00 PT — we have ~3h to verify. If patch lands & CI green, OK to proceed.

oliver: Another low-risk option: temporary canary using sampleapp v1.2.3 (previous stable image) to avoid touching tests.

sam: Canary seems less risky. How do we flip that config at release time?

kevin: Quick change to release-config: set SAMPLEAPP_TAG=v1.2.3 in canary pipeline. I can open PR and yolo-merge if we decide to go that route.

maria: Who signs off post-merge? Need QA + docs ack before cut.

anita: QA: I'll run a manual smoke on a small instance and post results here.

ci-bot: New artifact for PR 4827 — https://ci.internal/artifacts/4827 — excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18 15:42:01] test_retry_backoff -- timeout after 30s
[2026-03-18 15:42:01] stacktrace ...
```

kevin: PR 4827 opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/devexp/pull/4827 — changes: increase timeout + retry loop (no API changes).

sam: Running local reproduce now, will post results in ~10m.

maria: Ops decision: if PR is green before 16:30 PT, we take the patch route. If not, flip canary to v1.2.3 and proceed.

jen: I'll hold the changelog gate open for 30m after a green CI signal. :+1:

anita: Manual smoke passed on g4dn.xlarge — sampleapp startup + 3 quick queries OK, memory/latency looks normal.

ci-bot: CI PR 4827 — build 1747013300 — all checks passed ✅

maria: OK — clear to merge. kevin pls merge & tag the sampleapp bump. Who will trigger canary rollout?

kevin: Merged & bumped sampleapp image to sha256:abc123. I'll start canary rollout to dedicated envs now.

oliver: Monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/quickstarts/sampleapp — watching for error spikes. Will ping if any regressions.

maria: Thanks all. I'll update the release checklist and notify growth/sales about a brief delay.

jen: Noted, updating changelog state to "awaiting final CI" — will cut once we have stable signal.

sam: Nice quick turnaround, thanks everyone. :rocket:
